exercises.name: Seated Chest Press
exercises.tips: Keep back flat on the pad, press without locking elbows hard

exercises.name: Single-Arm Chest Press
exercises.tips: Great for fixing left-right strength imbalance

exercises.name: Standard Leg Press
exercises.tips: Feet shoulder-width, never lock knees at the top

exercises.name: Wide-Stance Leg Press
exercises.tips: Higher + wider feet shifts work to glutes and hamstrings

exercises.name: Calf Press on Leg Press
exercises.tips: Press with the balls of your feet, pause at the top

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.tips: Pull bar to upper chest, avoid leaning back too far

exercises.name: Close-Grip / Neutral-Grip Pulldown
exercises.tips: Squeeze shoulder blades together at the bottom

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.tips: Keep arms almost straight, feel it purely in the lats

exercises.name: Steady-State Walk / Jog
exercises.tips: Keep a pace where you can still talk comfortably

exercises.name: Incline Interval Walk
exercises.tips: Alternate 2 min incline / 2 min flat, great fat burner

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.tips: Don't clang dumbbells together at the top

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.tips: Pull with your elbow, not your hand

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.tips: Hold dumbbell at chest, keep torso upright

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.tips: Brace your core, knees track over toes

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.tips: Squeeze glutes to stop lower-back arching

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
exercises.tips: Step long enough that front knee stays over ankle

exercises.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
exercises.tips: Slight elbow bend, hug a giant tree

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
exercises.tips: Targets upper chest, squeeze at the top

exercises.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
exercises.tips: Elbows pinned to sides, split rope at the bottom

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press
exercises.tips: Set seat so handles are at ear height

exercises.name: Partial Rep Burnout
exercises.tips: Finish shoulders with light weight, top-half reps

exercises.name: Standard Leg Extension
exercises.tips: Pause 1 second at the top, control the way down

exercises.name: Single-Leg Extension
exercises.tips: Fixes imbalances, go lighter than two-leg version

exercises.name: Lying / Seated Leg Curl
exercises.tips: Don't lift hips off the pad, slow negatives

exercises.name: Single-Leg Curl
exercises.tips: Great finisher after heavy compound lifts
